descriptionNullable:
# S6E10 · 17 ablation members (OOF + test)

Out-of-fold and test predictions of 17 models from the development of
[S6E10 | Encodings + CatBoost + RealMLP](https://www.kaggle.com/code/kagankoral/s6e10-encodings-catboost-realmlp-lb-0-961).
None of them is in that notebook's `oof_members.csv`, which holds a separate Kaggle run of five models.
They were trained locally over ten rounds of paired ablation: raw-feature models, two encoding stages, 10-fold
versions, two all-categorical CatBoost settings and three RealMLP runs.

## Files

- `oof_<member>.npy`: out-of-fold probability for every row of `train.csv`, in `train.csv` order (699,635 values).
- `test_<member>.npy`: test probability for every row of `test.csv`, in `test.csv` order (299,844 values), averaged over the folds.
- `members.csv`: member name, OOF AUC, fold count, features and model.

All values are probabilities in [0, 1], stored as float64.

## Folds

- `_k5` members: `StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)` on `train.csv` order, the split most public OOF libraries use.
- `_k10` members: `StratifiedKFold(10, shuffle=True, random_state=42)`.

Every OOF value comes from a model that did not see that row. The tree models early-stop on the validation fold,
and RealMLP keeps its best epoch by validation AUC, so like most public OOFs they are very slightly optimistic.
The target encodings (`te`, `te_pair`) are rebuilt inside every fold, with an inner out-of-fold encoding for the
training rows.

## Features

| name | meaning |
|---|---|
| raw | the 21 competition columns, categoricals as integers, NaN kept |
| `orig_pred` | a LightGBM trained only on the original Airline Passenger Satisfaction survey (no competition label) |
| `orig_te` | satisfaction rate per exact value of every column, in the original survey |
| `freq` | value counts of age, flight distance and the delays over train + test |
| `te` | out-of-fold target encoding of age and flight distance |
| `te_pair` | the same for class / type of travel × flight distance and class / type of travel / customer type × age |
| enc3 | raw + `orig_pred` + `orig_te` + `freq` + `te` |

## Members

| member | OOF AUC | folds |
|---|---|---|
| lgb_raw_k5 / xgb_raw_k5 / cat_raw_k5 | 0.959041 / 0.958899 / 0.958711 | 5 |
| lgb_enc3_k5 / xgb_enc3_k5 / cat_enc3_k5 | 0.960585 / 0.960590 / 0.960635 | 5 |
| lgb_enc4_k5 / xgb_enc4_k5 / cat_enc4_k5 (enc3 + `te_pair`) | 0.960731 / 0.960793 / 0.960805 | 5 |
| lgb_enc4_k10 / xgb_enc4_k10 / cat_enc4_k10 | 0.960987 / 0.960972 / 0.961022 | 10 |
| cat_allcat_v1_k5 (every raw column also categorical, `l2_leaf_reg` 3) | 0.961095 | 5 |
| cat_allcat_v2_k5 (the same without our own TE, `l2_leaf_reg` 10) | 0.961127 | 5 |
| realmlp_raw_s42_k5 / realmlp_raw_s7_k5 (raw columns + categorical twins) | 0.960883 / 0.960885 | 5 |
| realmlp_enc_k5 (the same + the engineered features) | 0.960956 | 5 |

## Loading

```python
import glob, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
d = os.path.dirname(glob.glob('/kaggle/input/**/s6e10-ablation-members-oof/members.csv', recursive=True)[0])
card = pd.read_csv(f'{d}/members.csv')
oof = {m: np.load(f'{d}/oof_{m}.npy') for m in card['member']}
test = {m: np.load(f'{d}/test_{m}.npy') for m in card['member']}
```

## Credits

The all-categorical CatBoost settings, the RealMLP recipe and its `flat_anneal` schedule follow goodpjw2008's S6E10
series (RealMLP hyperparameters credited there to Vladimir Demidov); RealMLP is from pytabkit.
